raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / MERVILLE - CASA NEL PARCO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Merville - Casa nel Parco JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €1,050,000 Photos (25) Floor plans (0) 1 / 25 FLOOR AREA 120 m² LIFT No ENERGY CLASS C Overview JESOLO PINETA – RESIDENCE MERVILLE Within the prestigious Residence Merville – House in the Park, we offer for sale an elegant three-room apartment located in one of the most exclusive and recognizable residential contexts of the Jesolo coastline. The apartment features a bright living area with an open kitchen, two bedrooms, and pleasant outdoor spaces, ideal for enjoying moments of relaxation immersed in greenery and tranquility of the pine forest. The kitchen and furnishings enhance the environment with refined finishes, contemporary lines, and high-quality materials. The complex was designed by architect Gonçalo Byrne together with landscape designer João Ferreira Nunes, set within a seaside pine forest of approximately 50,000 square meters and includes a wonderful private park spanning about 20,000 square meters. Residents can enjoy numerous exclusive services: * large swimming pools with hydromassage areas and water games; * direct access to the beach; * fully glazed communal gym; * sauna and changing rooms; * spacious well-maintained green areas; * bar and restaurant within the complex; * parking lots and underground garages. Residence Merville also utilizes advanced energy systems including geothermal energy, photovoltaics, and heat recovery to ensure comfortable living conditions along with high efficiency. An ideal solution both as a prestigious seaside home or as a high-level real estate investment in a unique position between the greenery of the pine forest and Jesolo's sea. For more information, documentation or to arrange a visit: JBC IMMOBILIARE Piazza Drago 18 – Jesolo Contact us to discover all details about this property.
